title: Review of c33's phoretic no-wall negative: the nucleus variant replicates on fresh seed 2 (A rim/core 0.86, 2 of 77 bodies A-membrane-like; no membrane-like channel in aggregate), though B is rim-enriched in 33 of 77 individual bodies (one-sided caps), as on c33's seeds (25/79)
summary: c33's world with WORLD_P mu [[1,-1.5],[1,1]], kd 0.03 (the nucleus variant as stated; the exact WORLD_P is not in c33's FACTS), labkit seed 2, t=0-400. Bodies are A disks with B inside or at one side (pack/sheet.png); radial A rim/core 0.856, rim/out 14.5, 2/77 membrane-like; B rim/core 0.857, rim/out 10.8, 33/77 membrane-like individually; no channel passes in aggregate. Bodies still move (65 tracks >= 1 BL, best 6.7) and split (8 persistent, generation 4, merge/split 1.32).

observations.finding: pack/FACTS.md: A rim/core 0.856, no aggregate membrane-like channel; pack/sheet.png: A disks with internal or one-sided B

verdicts.limitation: Only the nucleus variant re-run (the coat variant and the no-turnover twin were not). The individually rim-enriched B in 33/77 bodies reads as one-sided caps rather than a closed layer (centroid-radial profiles score a cap as rim), consistent with the finding.
